gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-nunito: Comic Relief has bowls left open on one side and uniform strokes. Nunito, a sans-serif with big round lowercase and terminals stopping well short of the stem, sits taller and softer beneath it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans reads crisply, its apertures staying open at tiny sizes and its strokes holding one thickness in every direction. Comic Relief's loopy, bold display letters sit above it with plenty of swagger.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Loud, loopy and unfinished at the edges. Alegreya Sans SC, a sans-serif with a welcoming gap in the c, sits below it, while the heading's diagonals match its horizontals in thickness.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-almarai: Almarai reads cleanly, with a line width that never swells or tapers and letters that never pinch shut. Comic Relief is the one for a loud, bold heading; this sans-serif is the one for quiet text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-amarna: Commanding, yes, but a little goofy too, with Comic Relief's bowls left open on one side. Amarna, a sans-serif with contrast-free strokes and unclogged small counters, feels tidier and cooler right beside it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-antic: Comic Relief draws strokes with no visible difference between up and side, and bowls left unfinished on one side. Antic looks drawn with one nib, its open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, so it holds quiet text where the heading shouts.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-assistant: Bent plastic tubing, looped into letters. Assistant, a sans-serif with mouths that stay open on c, e and a, is the pair's best quality: a low, quiet body under such a bold heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-barlow: Bold, bouncy and a little unfinished. Barlow, a sans-serif with neon-tube constant strokes and c shapes with tips pulled well apart, is the approachable counterpart that makes this pair easy to like.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bpmf-huninn: Big, loud and slightly unfinished, Comic Relief takes the lead with bowls left open on one side. Bpmf Huninn, a sans-serif with a single-weight outline feel, stays modern and open beneath it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cairo: Cairo reads openly, with a broad channel leading into each bowl and low, modern letters. Its strongest quality is how it steps aside for Comic Relief, whose curves meet stems without any swelling.
